guardrails: Avoid using flat, solid colored backgrounds; depth is essential.
Do not use harsh, square-cornered buttons; stick to high-pill radius rounded corners.
Avoid busy or textured overlays that might distract from the clean readability of the white typography.
Never use multiple bright accent colors; stick strictly to the blue/white/black palette.
design.centerpiece: A dynamic vertical fin/slit background with a deep blue gradient that creates a sense of rhythmic depth and motion.
design.layout: A centered hero composition with a top-aligned navigation bar. Typography is stacked vertically in the center, utilizing a heavy contrast in scale between headline and sub-headline, followed by twin CTA buttons.

typography.display: Instrument Serif, serif for emphasis and Inter, sans-serif bold for the main headline
typography.mono: JetBrains Mono or similar clean monospace for small labels (if applicable)

design.motion: Subtle parallax or horizontal shifting on the vertical fins to imply depth as the user moves their cursor. Text should utilize a clean, upward fade-in stagger animation upon page load.
design.mood: A premium, high-tech, and futuristic aesthetic that feels both mysterious and highly efficient.
